name: Crystal Description
description: Generate Robocrys descriptions from CIF structures through the existing hosted Streamlit Python service. Files are processed by that external backend.
features: CIF structure descriptions generated by the hosted Robocrys Python backend
Embedded Streamlit workspace with a direct service link
SnO₂ example, copy and download within the original service
Community-hosted service; confidential structures should not be uploaded
CrystalDesk Windows client requires developer-issued machine-bound activation via a .cdlicense file

history.notes: Added the TMCCDB Crystal Description workspace to NexoraLab, retaining its existing hosted Python service.

zh.description: 通过现有托管的 Streamlit Python 服务，使用 Robocrys 从 CIF 结构生成描述。文件由该外部后端处理。
features: 由托管的 Robocrys Python 后端生成 CIF 结构描述
嵌入 Streamlit 工作区，并提供直接打开服务的入口
保留原服务的 SnO₂ 示例、复制和下载功能
使用社区托管服务，请勿上传保密结构
CrystalDesk Windows 客户端通过开发者签发的 .cdlicense 文件完成本机激活
